Item.name: NoInit
Item.description: No initialization (start values are used as guess values with fixed=false)

Item.name: SteadyState
Item.description: Steady state initialization (derivatives of states are zero)

Item.name: InitialOutput
Item.description: Initialization with initial outputs (and steady state of the states if possible)

Item.name: UpperLimit
Item.description: Simplified model fixed at upper limit

Item.name: LowerLimit
Item.description: Simplified model fixed at lower limit

ScalarVariable.name: sim.visualizeWarnings
ScalarVariable.description: If true, unphysical behaviour will be visualized

ScalarVariable.name: sim.generateEventsAtFlowReversalGas
ScalarVariable.description: If true: all gas components generate events at flow reversal

ScalarVariable.name: sim.generateEventsAtFlowReversalLiquid
ScalarVariable.description: If true: all liquid components generate events at flow reversal

ScalarVariable.name: sim.generateEventsAtFlowReversalVLEFluid
ScalarVariable.description: If true: all VLEFluid components generate events at flow reversal

ScalarVariable.name: sim.includeSummaryChoice
ScalarVariable.description: Include summaries: 1. force use; 2. force use not; 3. defined by model

ScalarVariable.name: m_wanted
ScalarVariable.description: flow I want in the circuit, kg/s -- recalibrated 2026-07-28 from debugging/result.mat (sensor_m_flow.sensorValue averaged ~0.895 kg/s over t=1600-1815s, still rising ~0.03 kg/s/100s at end of run -- old value of 0.095 predated the coil-geometry/isolation changes and no longer matched the achieved flow by ~10x)

ScalarVariable.name: m_total
ScalarVariable.description: total flow from the pump, kg/s

ScalarVariable.name: Kv_circuit
ScalarVariable.description: Equivalent Kv (m3/h) of the circuit branch (junction5.portC -> ... -> junction4.portA), as seen in parallel with valve1's bypass branch across the shared junction5/junction4 dp -- measured 2026-07-28 from debugging/result.mat via two independent methods (flow-ratio: 5.49 m3/h; direct dp/mdot/rho: 4.99 m3/h), re-identify with debugging/identify_circuit_kv.py if the coil/header geometry changes again

ScalarVariable.name: hysteresisHalfWidth
ScalarVariable.description: Half-width of the ON/OFF gap around each PID.y switching threshold (heater/cooling/bypass), prevents state-event chattering when PID.y settles right on a threshold

ScalarVariable.name: tempMargin
ScalarVariable.description: Margin below the hottest coil-assembly gas outlet temperature

ScalarVariable.name: overCoolShutMargin
ScalarVariable.description: valve4 shuts once sensor_T.sensorValue rises to T_ref - overCoolShutMargin (T_ref = T_gas_out_max snapshot recorded at the moment valve4 last reopened)

ScalarVariable.name: overCoolReopenMargin
ScalarVariable.description: valve4 reopens (and re-records T_ref = current T_gas_out_max) once T_gas_out_max - sensor_T.sensorValue exceeds this, while shut

ScalarVariable.name: coilIsolationCloseMargin
ScalarVariable.description: Per-coil isolation valve closes once T_gas_out is this much colder than T_gas_out_max

ScalarVariable.name: coilIsolationReopenMargin
ScalarVariable.description: Per-coil isolation valve reopens once within this much of T_gas_out_max

ScalarVariable.name: controlActivationDelay
ScalarVariable.description: Reopen logic (valve4 and per-coil isolation) stays disabled until this much simulated time has passed, so it isn't triggered by unsettled startup temperatures

ScalarVariable.name: m_flow_startup
ScalarVariable.description: Circuit flow target valve1 bypasses down to for the first controlActivationDelay seconds (same startup window as the reopen-logic delay above), so coil temperatures can be read before valve1 releases to the normal m_wanted trim control, kg/s

ScalarVariable.name: T_ref
ScalarVariable.description: T_gas_out_max snapshot for valve4's own control logic only (PID/wanted_temp are unaffected) -- re-recorded every time valve4 reopens, held constant otherwise

ScalarVariable.name: valve4Open
ScalarVariable.description: true -> valve4 Kv=5000 (open), false -> valve4 Kv=0.001 (shut)
